high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot from an Instagram post by Narendra Modi, the Prime Minister of India. The post is dated 22 hours prior to the screenshot being taken at 11:28 PM. The text on the post reads: "Glad to have met PM Mario Draghi in Rome. We talked about ways to strengthen the friendship between India and Italy." The photo accompanying the post shows two men standing side by side in front of a backdrop featuring flags.
